SOURCES.census_districts: Census of India 2011 district table (population, sex ratio, literacy, density, growth) - census2011.co.in mirror of Census data; same totals as Economic Survey of Delhi, delhiplanning.delhi.gov.in
SOURCES.child_0_6: Census 2011 Provisional Population Totals, NCT Delhi: 0-6 population by district (total 1,970,510). South Delhi = total minus the other 8 districts (DERIVED).
SOURCES.pm25_city: CSE/CREA analysis of CPCB real-time data: Delhi 2025 annual PM2.5 = 96 ug/m3 (2024: ~105); Delhi Economic Survey 2025-26 (CAAQMS): 100 ug/m3. All 40 stations >= 1.8x NAAQS(40) i.e. >= 72.
SOURCES.pm25_stations: CSE analysis of CPCB data (Business Standard, Dec 2025): Jahangirpuri 119, Bawana/Wazirpur 113, Anand Vihar 111, Mundka/Rohini/Ashok Vihar 101-103; CSE/CREA 2025 (Tribune): Jahangirpuri 130; CSE 2024-25: Anand Vihar annual 136.
SOURCES.yamuna: CPCB NWMP monthly data Jan-Jun 2025 (PIB release 2150744, Ministry of Jal Shakti, 31 Jul 2025); standards DO>5, BOD<3, FC<2500 MPN/100ml.
SOURCES.sewage: PIB 2150744 (DJB data): sewage generated 3,596 MLD; 37 STPs capacity 3,474 MLD; utilised 2,955 MLD (June 2025); 2,014 MLD compliant with DPCC norms; ~641 MLD untreated.
SOURCES.water_access: Delhi Economic Survey 2025-26: 93.5% households have piped water; about one-third of Delhi lives in sub-standard housing (Economic Survey of Delhi, Ch.14).
SOURCES.mortality: SRS Statistical Report 2023 (ORGI): Delhi crude death rate 4.5 per 1,000.
SOURCES.exposure_response: Lancet Planetary Health (Ljungman et al., 2024, 10 Indian cities): +1.42% daily deaths per 10 ug/m3 PM2.5 (2-day), WHO 15 ug/m3 reference; Delhi 11.5% of deaths (~12,000/yr) attributable, 2008-2019.

ASSUMPTIONS.station_shrinkage_k: U(1,4): district PM = n/(n+k)*station mean + (1-n/(n+k))*city mean, because monitors sit at hotspots (base k=2)
ASSUMPTIONS.unmeasured_districts: relative factor U(0.8,1.2), then rescaled so the population-weighted mean equals the city mean, floored at 72
ASSUMPTIONS.informal_share: city mean U(0.30,0.36) ('about one-third in sub-standard housing'); allocated to districts in proportion to illiteracy (PROXY - replace with Census slum data via --informal)
ASSUMPTIONS.water_reach_map: districts on/near polluted drains and the downstream Yamuna get the mean downstream index; North gets the mean of upstream (Palla) and downstream; multiplier U(0.7,1.0)
ASSUMPTIONS.weights: air weight w_a U(0.5,0.75) (stronger health evidence than for water); child weight w_c U(0.3,0.7)
ASSUMPTIONS.water_scenarios: water hazard scales linearly with the non-compliant share of sewage (first-order)
ASSUMPTIONS.susceptibility: base case = 1.0 for all groups (no invented amplification); sensitivity run uses 1.25 for children and informal residents (illustrative)
